title: A Real Artist Joins the Team
synopsis: Kit brings in Pixel to draw the comics with a real image model and character sheets; Glitch gives Sam cat ears, so every prompt now says who is human.
altText: Panel 1: Sam and Kit look at a plain, flat comic and want better art. Panel 2: Pixel the cat paints character sheets of the cast at an easel while Kit cheers. Panel 3: Glitch the beetle proudly shows a drawing of Sam with cat ears, and Sam is shocked. Panel 4: Kit, Pixel and Sam admire a finished, consistent comic page together.

panels.scene: Sam and Kit at the desk, looking at a monitor showing a plain, flat cartoon page.

dialogue.speaker: sam
dialogue.text: Our comics look like clip art.

panels.scene: Pixel the cat paints character portraits of Sam, Kit and Glitch on an easel, while Kit cheers beside it.

dialogue.speaker: pixel
dialogue.text: Character sheets first. Everyone stays on model.

panels.scene: Glitch the beetle proudly holds up a small drawing of Sam with cat ears; Sam stares at it, shocked.
Kit, Pixel and Sam admire a finished, colorful comic page pinned to the wall.

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: Now every prompt says who's human.

dialogue.speaker: sam
dialogue.text: And it's still me next episode.
